summary: Add text to videos: each library video with a file has Add text, which opens an editor that puts animated text (fade, pop, slide up, typewriter) on the video per scene or time range. Grok writes a line per scene from the brand, category, video and an optional direction; Nate edits everything, previews it live, and Save video records a new video with the text into the same category (the original stays). Text videos remember their source and texts, so Edit text changes them again.
